SINGPUR, POLICE STATION AND TEHSIL BARGHAT,
 DISTRICT SEONI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI RAHUL KUMAR TRIPATHI - ADVOCATE )
 AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION BARGHAT DISTRICT SEONI  (MADHYA PRADESH)

2 . VICTIM A S/O NOT MENTION OCCUPATION: NOT  MENTION THROUGH POLICE STATION BARGHAT,
 DISTRICT SEONI (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY SHRI PRAMOD KUMAR CHOUBEY - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE  This application coming on for admission this  following:
 ORDER
This is the first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been implicated in connection with Crime No.512/2022, registered at Police Station, Barghat, District - Seoni (M.P.) for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376,
376(3), 376(2)(cha) of IPC and Section 5n & of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 12.10.2022.
As per prosecution case, the allegation against the present applicant is that on 06.04.2022 took the prosecutrix at his home and committed rape upon her, due to which she became pregnant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, a case has been registered against the present applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence due to old enmity between parties.
Applicant is only 24 years old.
The FIR was lodged after a delay of more than 05 months and there is no plausible explanation has been assigned for the aforesaid delay.
It is further submitted that, as per the DNA report, applicant is not the biological father of the newly born child.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 12.10.2022.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail.
Learned Deputy Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant and also taking note of the fact as per DNA report, applicant is not the biological father of the newly born child; therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified Copy, as per rules.
(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE Amitabh Abhishek vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117254211/
